items.prompt: Generate a standalone BACKGROUND ART LAYER for the layered Godot game scene "幽界群像". The supplied image is only a painting reference, especially the dark water continuing beneath ALL its UI. Output one full 16:9 2400x1350 landscape ENVIRONMENT PLATE. NO user interface, lettering, numerals, frames, symbols, buildings, islands, people, relics, gods or solid platforms. Only the continuous abyssal sea and its inseparable sea-mist, seen steeply downward from high overhead with NO horizon line or sky. Match the reference's rich, tactile, dark blue-black/teal waves: individually visible flowing wave ridges and deep troughs, scattered broken pale-cyan glints, a few isolated muted warm-gold reflections where light could reach from an absent structure. Sophisticated painted realism, crisp texture near the bottom, intermediate rippling water in the middle, ambiguous slow broad sea swells dissolving into soft layered mist at the top and side distance. Wave crests naturally become vapor wisps; mist has the same flowing direction and some dark holes revealing water, NOT a white fog overlay. Slightly calmer, darker area around central 55% for a separately placed sanctuary. Preserve tonal depth and luminous surface detail; do not flatten into a smooth gradient, noisy mottled texture, storm splash, bright aerial ocean photograph or uniformly low contrast. Sea remains fully painted all the way to edges and lower corners so transparent control gaps reveal the same world. Light comes from upper left, muted cool reflections with very sparse warm points; no actual visible light sources. High-quality finished hand-painted game background, no vignette UI decorations. This is one reusable bottom layer, no other assets baked in.

Create ONE separate transparent-background painted environment sprite for a layered Godot scene, faithful to the central mirror-cult architectural sanctuary in these visual references. Subject only: a whole weathered pale-stone sanctuary on a fragmented rocky platform, seen high and far from above, steep downward 65 degree god's-eye isometric perspective. Circular witness-court with thick stone steps and projecting terraces, 5–7 tall asymmetric upright polished mirror slabs and modest broken pillar structures, fine worn brass supports, small clusters of candlelight, a few tiny black-robed human silhouettes occupying only a few pixels at final scale. No giant faces/statues/eye motif painted on mirrors. The site is an organization seen at distance, not a close interior. It should have the exquisite sculptural volume, crisp stone turning planes, dark cliff undercuts, reflected cool environment light and warm lamp glow of the references. Upper surfaces ivory gray, sides dark teal gray, small realistic amber highlights. Local lights illuminate nearby actual surfaces; no uniform gold outline around the island. Whole site fits a wide horizontal silhouette with stepped irregular edges and bottom cliff fragments; transparent outside, including open gaps. No rectangle backdrop, no sea, sky, fog, horizon, labels, UI, frames or text. Do NOT include other surrounding islands. Color is rich and nuanced, not a flat gray model. Output approx1536x1024 with the site filling about90% of width and72% ofheight, fully within canvas, true alpha. It will be displayed around780x470 over a separately painted sea. Keep the same original game's sophisticated painted miniature realism and all edges usable for compositing.

Produce one transparent-background GAME UI MATERIAL ATLAS for this exact reference's original ornate painterly interface. NOT a screenshot, no text. Three long EMPTY horizontal plaque skins stacked vertically in exactly three equal rows. Overall canvas1536x1024, each row fullwidth1536 height about341. The skin in eachrow lies wholly inside margin32 on all four sides, centered, approx1472x240. Nothing overlaps row boundaries. No labels, numbers, pictograms or scenery. Each plaque is a complete rectangular horizontal nine-slice-compatible skin with straight extendable middle edges and lovingly painted irregular small cornerwork, antique gold/bronze organic twig-and-filigree edges, crisp scratches, dark edge thickness and tiny glints. Match reference game materials with high artistic finish. Row1: normal reading plaque, midnight teal-black mineral/oil surface, mostly quiet central face, fine oldgold decorative edges, transparent nicks outside the frame. Row2: hover/focused dark plaque, the same design but a strong ivorygold rim-light and gentle LOCAL halo just outside the edge, warm light fading a little onto the dark inner surface, still dark-center. Row3: selected/primary ivory plaque, aged pale parchment-or-ivory surface with subtle irregular warm grain and gold/bronze corner fittings, soft glowing selected edge; face light enough for dark ink text. Material variations have genuine painted irregular edges rather than sterile CSS rounded rectangles. Corners beautiful but not huge; whole panels have different body/light behavior rather than merely recoloring a thin line. Center faces kept empty and quiet for live native text. Transparent background outside each independent skin. No fake checkerboard. Strict3rows exactly, useful separable atlas, no added symbols.
